name: Cell-Type Co-occurrence
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Which cell types are found near each other more often than expected by chance.

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.help: Sets the maximum distance at which two cells count as neighbours, using the dataset's own coordinate units. Check the scale bar and start with about two or three cell diameters.

params.name: field
params.label: Grouping column
params.help: Selects the annotation used to define the groups being compared. Defaults to the cell-type column.
